input_domain.machine_mode: LONG_64; address width 64, as fixed by decode-harness.c
input_domain.state: Fresh decoded-instruction structure, initialized XED tables, valid readable input buffer and writable output structure; chip selection follows the harness zero-initialization.
input_domain.full_decoder: All supplied byte strings up to the decoder length bound, including malformed and unsupported encodings; preserve XED error behavior.
input_domain.family_decoder: Inputs whose successful XED decoding belongs to the named catalog family, across its admitted variants. Current scope retains all record modes as an overapproximation.
input_domain.outside_family: Not covered by the restricted-domain theorem. A total membership/rejection wrapper requires a separate recognizer proof or the full decoder; successful-family scope alone cannot justify rejection.
input_domain.precision: Preserve decoded length, instruction identity, operand/register selection, widths, addressing/displacements, immediates, prefixes, and output/error state; family recognition alone is insufficient.

obligations.work: Validate raw-pattern catalog against generated/build-admitted definitions and record identities. Existing compiled-name checks establish that selected lookup functions exist, not that every accepted variant was enumerated.

Prove map/opcode selection, instruction-record indices, lookup bucket bounds and pointer-table layouts, including invalid handlers; validate remaining Ddisasm indirect branches. Static recovered target sets are candidates, not proofs.

Establish the initialized-table invariant once, or include and lift xed_tables_init. The packaged initializer also initializes encoder tables. Preserve relocations and static data in the modeled state.

Instantiate AU recipes for required encodings and validate their semantics; resolve direct-model relocation, ungeneralized cases, unmatched cases and absent forms. Existing applicability counts alone discharge none of these proofs.
Supply __stack_chk_fail as a nonreturning contract, or prove the stack guard cannot fail within the admitted state domain. No libc implementation closure.

Compose instruction STSes with memory, control flow and call/return state, using existing Lean embedding and equivalence tooling. Prove the restricted domain and projection preserve full decoded output, not just opcode identity.

analysis_limits: Per-family scopes are conservative candidate envelopes, not proven minimal paths.
Scope-size/gap-count ordering is a reproducible prioritization proxy, not an effort estimate or globally optimal PR order.
A form/status group may contain many distinct AU cases; zero new groups does not mean zero new case work.
FP guest instructions do not imply FP host arithmetic in a decoder. Initialization SIMD work is separate from FP theory.
